title: Addressed iterated tribes
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a Boolean function on assignments of signs to the depth-$k$ addresses of a quaternary tree as follows: at depth zero, return the sign at the unique address; at depth $k+1$, group the addresses by their first coordinate, apply the depth-$k$ function to each resulting subtree, and apply the tribes function with block width and number of blocks both equal to $2$ to the two outputs.
